At HEAD 8105ad0e those checks fail; disposition is invalid until the named receipts exist with the required fields. When they do, cite the written FINAL_CLASSIFICATION.outcome_b_checks all-true (or equivalent recomputation) and the concrete receipt files, not this placeholder. The gates are evidenced by the receipts publish() reads, not by its own output.
